items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: StyleX design tokens every component builds on.
items.docs: Needs the StyleX compiler with an `@/*` alias, the Radix gray, gray-alpha, gray-dark, gray-dark-alpha and black-alpha CSS imported once, and `color-scheme: dark` on `.dark`. Setup: https://ui.aayush.cv

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Quiet notifications that stack, follow a promise and swipe away.
items.docs: Render <Toaster /> once near the root, then call toast.add({ title }) from anywhere.
